stem: In the \(xy\)-plane, line \(\ell\) has equation \(ax + 4y = 20\), where \(a\) is a constant. Line \(\ell\) is perpendicular to the line that passes through the points \((1, 1)\) and \((a, 7)\). What is the value of \(a\)?
solution: Line \(\ell\) has slope \(-\frac{a}{4}\). The other line has slope \(\frac{6}{a - 1}\).
verify:
a = symbols('a')
sol = solve(Eq(-a/4 * 6/(a - 1), -1), a)
assert sol == [-2]
assert Rational(2, 4) * Rational(6, -3) == -1
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == sol
